<objective>
Separate `upload-modal`'s image-processing orchestration and form-validation logic into two dedicated injectable services (CONCERNS.md fix approach: "Separate image processing logic from form handling"; D-03). This is distinct from the EXISTING `ImageProcessingService` (which already does the low-level crop/compress pixel work and is NOT modified by this phase, per RESEARCH.md) — this plan extracts the modal's ORCHESTRATION of that service (validate → crop → compress → generate preview URL, with fallback-on-error branching) plus the three `ValidatorFn` factories that currently live as private methods on the modal.

`UploadImagePipelineService` wraps the existing `ImageProcessingService` calls (`autoCropImage`, `compressImage`) plus `FileReader`-based preview generation and the type/size validation, returning a plain result object — it does not touch `uploadForm` (D-03 mirrors D-01's form-agnostic rule). `upload-modal`'s `onFileSelected` (rewired in Plan 07) calls this service and then patches its own form fields (e.g., `name`) from the result.

`UploadFormValidatorsService` relocates `uniqueNameValidator`/`sliderRangeValidator`/`heightValidator` as factory methods returning `ValidatorFn`s, injecting `IndexedDBUserModelService` for the name-uniqueness check exactly as today — validation LOGIC is unchanged, only its file location moves.

Purpose: Shrink `upload-modal.component.ts` toward the ~400-line target (DECOMP-01) by relocating ~180 lines of file-processing orchestration and ~70 lines of validators.
Output: Two new services + specs, ready for Plan 07 to wire into the thinned shell.
</objective>

Write `upload-image-pipeline.service.spec.ts` covering: invalid type rejection (exact error string), oversized rejection (exact error string), successful pass-through with crop+compression disabled, crop-failure fallback path, and compression-failure fallback path — using `jasmine.createSpyObj('ImageProcessingService', ['autoCropImage','compressImage'])` mirroring the existing spec's mocking style.
